author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Behested payments totalled $6.6 million since 2019; 49% came from payors who were interested parties at the time.
paragraphs: A behested payment is money an official asks a third party to give to a cause, disclosed by the official. They fund real services (shelters, festivals, relief) and they are also the channel that the 2022 ordinance restricted because of the Public Works scandal. The chart shows totals by official, by payor type and over time.
'Interested party' here is computed: the payor had a contract, permit or lobbying matter before the official's department within 12 months. It is a flag to check, not a finding.
